steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease and flour two 9-inch round cake pans or line with parchment paper.

Beat flour, sugar, 3/4 cup water, cocoa powder, vegetable oil, salt, baking soda, and baking powder in a mixing bowl with an electric mixer on medium speed for 2 minutes. Add eggs, remaining 1/2 cup water, and vanilla extract; beat 2 minutes more. Pour batter into the prepared cake pans.

Bake in the preheated oven until surface of cakes spring back when lightly pressed and a toothpick inserted into centers comes out clean, about 30 minutes. Cool in the pans for 10 minutes before removing to a wire rack to cool completely.

raw_recipe.headline: Nairobi Chocolate Cake
raw_recipe.description: This oil-based Nairobi chocolate cake recipe with unsweetened cocoa powder is from the American Women's Association in Kenya from the late 1970s.
raw_recipe.name: Nairobi Chocolate Cake

review.reviewBody: DELISH! Made this today just as written. I used my homemade chocolate buttercream icing to go with it. My husband wants this cake for his birthday & any other time I'm looking to bake something. "efzed", do you have any other treats that we might find scrumptious?

I substituted apple juice for the water and followed the directions perfectly. I cooked it in a very well greased bundt pan for 37 minutes, dumped it out immediately and cooled it in the freezer. It came out perfectly! The texture of this cake is amazing! My family loved it. Next time I make this I'm going to try adding some orange zest for even more depth of flavor.

Mylove requested a chocolate cake with chocolate icing, from scratch, for his birthday. I made this cake as posted, except I only had 1/4 c. of oil. I did add unsweetened applesauce to the oil for the 3/4 c. needed. Turned out perfectly fine. I made a Buttercream Chocolate Frosting from this site also. I love a thick layer of icing and he likes a thin layer, so I spread more on “my side” and he ate that, too! Nary a complaint about the cake being too sweet. We both thoroughly enjoyed this one.

My first homemade cake. I had taken a simple cake and made a few mistakes. I had to give this a five star, because knowing now I was the one that made a few mistakes, it would have turned out more moist. I didn't use veg. oil, and I won't again. I used cal. oil, so less fat, might have been a problem. Next time I will add more real butter. I beat it by hand, next time I will use a hand mixer. I used a bundt pan (I love the look of bundt cakes) so by using a bundt pan with the thickness, I had to cook it a little longer. It wasn't real dry, just a touch. Everyone loved it. However, me wanted everything just right. I did top it with a buttercream chocolate frosting, and topped it with pecans. I'm looking forward to getting this just right the next time. My first homemade cake! not to bad....live and learn.

I LOVE THIS RECIPE!! I usually don't like chocolate cake but I had a craving today and I found this recipe. I followed it exactly and the result was amazing, moist, perfect amount of sweetness and the flavor was so good! I made cupcakes instead and it took about 15 minutes at 350. I made the first two batches just with the batter and the last batch I crushed up graham crackers and sprinkled it on top with mini marshmallows in the center, PLEASE TRY IT! :)

Added mini chocolate chips to batter, topped with cup of pecans. Family absolutely loved this cake! 
Definitely will become a favorite!

This is a wonderful cake! It is moist, rich, with a nice texture and it is super easy to make. I think it is even better on day two. I used a dark cocoa, 1 tsp of espresso powder, and coconut oil for the vegetable oil. I am sure I will make it again - thank you!
Excellent cake. I did substitute coffee for water.

This is an acceptable cake, but not one I’ll make again given the other, extraordinary chocolate cake recipes on this site. In addition to not being as dark chocolate as I assumed it would be, it wasn’t as moist or sweet as I would have liked either. It cries out, then, for a sweet buttercream frosting. I made this as cupcakes; a half recipe gave me 12 perfectly shaped and nicely rounded cupcakes. I frosted them with “Mint Buttercream Frosting with Dark Chocolate Glaze,” recipe also from this site. Edit 11-10-12: This was much improved simply by adding 1/4 c. more sugar and using strong, brewed coffee in place of the water.
Awesome. I've made it as a cake and as cupcakes. For 24 cupcakes bake at 350 for 20 min. I like to sprinkle powdered sugar on top once they have cooled, it makes for a nice finish.

Great recipe! I modified it to include healthier options so I feel good about letting my kids indulge. My mods are: organic coconut oil, organic sprouted wheat flour, organic cane sugar, organic coconut sugar AND I puréed 2 enormous handfuls of organic spinach to give it some extra moisture and vitamins. These silly kids didn't even know what they were really eating!
So delicious and such a simple recipe! I frosted it with Caroline's Chocolate Fudge Frosting from this site. Family loved it. Thanks for the recipe.
Easy to make and the finished cake turned out very eye appealing. I am used to a sweeter cake so will I do this again? It is worth a second chance with 1/4 cup added sugar.
Delicious! I make these as cupcakes, they come out great every time! They also freeze well for individual snacks :)
I love this recipe! My fiance only wants these cupcakes and now asks for them regularly. I'll never use another chocolate cake recipe.
Made this for my son's smash cake, it was good

I made this recipe exactly as written, and was quite pleased with the way it turned out. Might add a smidge more cocoa powder next time. I put it into a greased and floured 9x13 pan, and it was a tall cake! Okay by me. Topped it with cream cheese frosting, and shared with neighbors, who also enjoyed it. Thank you for this recipe. Will make, again!
I loved this cake. Very moist and was a big hit at our weekly family dinner.
I made this cake for a birthday party. It is moist and delicious. It got rave reviews! One person told me it was the best cake she had ever had. Another said she'd give it six stars if she could.
Our go-to chocolate cake. Delicious and easy!
